name: PLUG POWER INC
business: Plug Power sells hydrogen fuel cells, electrolyzers, liquid hydrogen fuel and service to material handling, industrial and energy customers worldwide.

events.what: President (2025-10-10), then CEO; Andy Marsh moved to Executive Chair, George McNamee named Lead Director
events.from: Plug Power Chief Revenue Officer (at Plug since 2014)

events.what: Crespo appointed to the board as Class III director
Director resigned (Audit and Strategy and Financing committees)
COO resigned to join another company (pending)

next_event.source: No 2026 investor day found. Plug holds an annual Symposium (2024-11-13, doc 65630; 2025-11-18, doc 47846) where the profitability roadmap was set and reaffirmed; Q4 2026 is the stated positive-EBITDA quarter (doc 131677). 2026 Symposium date not found in Baba.

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: Target is a sign threshold, not a percentage: positive EBITDA in Q4 2026 (recorded as 0% floor), then positive operating income in Q4 2027 and full profitability in 2028. Gross margin milestone (breakeven by Q4 2025) was hit: +2.4% in Q4 2025, about breakeven in Q2 2026.

street.gap_assumption: Target quarter is Q4 2026: VA 4QFY-2026 consensus EBITDA -27.2M on revenue 276.2M = -9.87%, versus management's positive EBITDA (0% floor). VA EBITDA basis may include non-cash items that Plug's own adjusted EBITDA excludes, so the gap may be overstated. Full-year FY2027 consensus is still negative (-80.9M) even though management says operating income turns positive in Q4 2027. VA labels equal calendar years (fyem 12). Quant notes: pctile_ev_ebitda_60m is on EV/Sales (data_comps pctile_metric ev_sales) because EBITDA is negative. ebitda_margin_ltm is Q2 2025 to Q1 2026 VA quarterly EBITDA, -1,135.0M / 739.8M (Q2 2026 actuals not yet loaded in VA), and includes large non-cash charges. ebitda_revision_12m of -9.6% is a sign artifact: FY2027 consensus EBITDA went from -89.5M to -80.9M, a smaller loss. ebitda_turn_pct is null in data_comps; computed 4-month change (2026-05-31 -101.0M to 2026-10-01 -80.9M) is +19.9% of the starting loss, about 2 points of margin, so D was scored on the gap test rather than read as a completed re-rating.
street.source: Baba data_financials consensus (summary, consensus_history pid 4250 FY-2027)

evidence_of_progress.note: Q1 2026 VA EBITDA margin -54.0% vs -114.6% in Q1 2025 (+6,061 bps, data_compute). Q2 2026 EBITDA not in VA; gross margin about breakeven vs -30.7% a year ago (CFO: roughly a 30-point improvement, doc 131677). Q4 2025 gross margin +2.4% vs -122.5% (doc 155688). Liquidity is thin: $162M unrestricted cash plus $510M restricted at 2026-06-30, Q2 net cash use $61M; 10-Q 0001104659-26-093454 concludes sufficient capital for at least 12 months, no going-concern doubt; $578M convertible notes, none due within 12 months.

verdict: Mechanically scores high (internal CEO 7 months in, dated positive-EBITDA target the street models about 990 bps short), but it is a cash-constrained turnaround, not a low-margin GXO-style operator.
open_questions: Does Plug's own adjusted EBITDA definition differ from VA's EBITDA, and how much of the 987 bps gap is definitional?
Can H2 revenue really run 40% above H1 and lift Q4 2026 EBITDA positive with $162M unrestricted cash and asset sales still pending?
Will the departing COO (2026-10-23) and the Q4 2026 test be followed by a 2026 Symposium that sets 2027 and 2028 numbers?
